title: Kasak
desc: Divya, a young woman, loves Suraj, who dies an unfortunate and untimely death. She is soon forced to marry Vijay due to familial pressure but not long after demands that he divorce her.

title: Phool Aur Angaar
desc: A young man rescues a woman from being molested but gets accused of the heinous crime instead. Trying to apprehend the miscreants, he gets caught in a web of deception and lies.

title: Guddi
desc: Kusum is obsessed with Bollywood movies and is unable to distinguish between the real world and the movie world, to the extent that she refuses to marry anyone besides her idol, Dharmendra.

title: Dastaan
desc: Vishnu, a reputed judge, is assumed to be Anil, an absconding murderer. However, he decides to travel to Anil's home town and unravel the mystery behind his lookalike's existence.
